final_draft.note: I couldn't find an approved answer or policy section about data residency. Three searches found nothing on where customer data is hosted, which country or region it's in, or whether a customer can choose Switzerland. The only related source is the approved backup answer (answer:4fff88fe-fc09-4ed6-b7d5-b13c874cd9ea, A1.2). It says production database backups are 'stored in a second region'. It doesn't name the primary or the second region, or say whether either could be in Switzerland. It also doesn't say whether backups could stay inside one country. So it can't answer the question either way. The live-settings checks don't cover hosting regions. The owner of data residency or infrastructure (for example security@harborlight.example) needs to give an approved answer before this can be answered.
